title: Segmantation Fault trying to add 2d Node - 4.5-rc1 - Linux 6.16.4 - Compatibility
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5-beta-7 and 4.5-rc1

### System information

Godot v4.5.rc1 - Gentoo 2.17 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (radeonsi, navi31, LLVM 19.1.7, DRM 3.64, 6.16.4-gentoo-dist) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 61.91 GiB memory

- switch to the 2d
- HBoxContainer should be selected
- Add Child Node ( I wanted to add a label )
